title: Replace the Substring for Balanced String
summary: Given a string s of length n with characters 'Q', 'W', 'E', and 'R', determine the shortest substring that can be replaced to make the string balanced, where a balanced string has each character appearing n/4 times.
statement: Given a string s of length n with characters 'Q', 'W', 'E', and 'R', determine the shortest substring that can be replaced to make the string balanced, where a balanced string has each character appearing n/4 times. If the string is already balanced, return 0.
constraints: s contains only Q, W, E, and R and its length is divisible by four.
Replace one contiguous substring with any same-length string.
Return the minimum replacement length that can make all four character counts equal.
hints: The replacement window must contain every occurrence exceeding the target count.
Maintain counts outside a sliding window.
Shrink while all four outside counts are at most length/4, recording the minimum window.
Any characters missing outside can be supplied inside, so the quota condition is necessary and sufficient.
editorial: Any characters missing outside can be supplied inside, so the quota condition is necessary and sufficient.

tests.explanation: The string is already balanced, so no replacement is needed.
Replacing one Q with R balances all four counts.
